hypothesis: After K2 qualifies natively, adding the fixed last-layer bigram and trigram tables with FP32 master parameters, gradients and RMS state can lower final fresh public-20M BPB enough to outweigh their startup, metadata, backward, reduction and optimizer costs within the official 1800-second budget.
single_causal_change: Enable the reviewed fixed layer-7 A1 table package on the qualified eight-layer K2 base; retain the K2 base's batch, schedule, matrix LR, data order, seed and all other scientific settings.
mechanism: The two causal hashed memories add learned bigram/trigram value capacity. Their dedicated ordered K2 backward uses the human-decided FP32 reference. Historical BF16 A1 lost +0.007157211744374 BPB on the old six-layer stack; the proposition that this new K2/FP32/eight-layer implementation changes that tradeoff remains a hypothesis and must be judged by a new fixed-budget result.
p_improve_event: candidate minus qualified same-host K2 control public-20M BPB <= -0.0010
prediction_note: Low-confidence subjective planning prior, not a fitted estimate, measurement, or gate. Host-hours cover one full run and attached evaluation after prerequisites, excluding the already-required K2 control and short native checks. EV is 0.30*abs(-0.001)/1.25. Native feasibility and even the sign of the BPB effect are unknown.

precision_contract.tables: Two zero-initialized FP32 Parameters[524288,128], b7/t7 at absolute layer7 only; use the reviewed fixed signed-int32 hash formula and padding8192.
precision_contract.forward: Gather from FP32 masters before converting only gathered activations to BF16. Never cast the whole table to BF16 before lookup.
precision_contract.gradients: Ordered per-occurrence FP32 accumulation of BF16 tangents; FP32 Parameter.grad, cross-microstep accumulation, distributed AVG and optimizer input. Do not substitute the historical BF16 collision-rounding oracle.
precision_contract.rms: FP32 master/state/update; beta1=0, beta2=0.999, epsilon1e-10, weight_decay0, bias correction and no_lr_decay, LR=0.3*(1024/768)^(-0.5)=0.2598076211353316.
precision_contract.ownership_and_clip: Tables are excluded from packed ownership/all-gather and receive one replicated RMS update per rank after AVG and joint table norm1 clipping. Ordinary parameters, projections and gates retain their separate main norm1 clip and original optimizer behavior.
precision_contract.checkpoint_and_eval: Production model-only checkpoint persists FP32 tables and the config flag; ordinary load_for_eval reconstructs the trained model and strict state. No evaluator adapter, optimizer resume, alternate model, validation training, tokenizer/data/scoring change or external weights.

trainium_feasibility.memory_limits: This is 512MiB weights + 512MiB dense gradients + 512MiB RMS state per rank, before metadata, activations, update temporaries, projections and gates. Native peak HBM fit is unproved until the short check; no full-size CPU test is added.
trainium_feasibility.compile_and_sbuf: Runtime row traversal avoids 4096 Python-unrolled bodies and uses bounded named scratch. A source/scratch-size estimate is not a native fit pass.
